listing.title: My First Winter Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Winter Pages – Snowman, Igloo, Arctic Fox & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of snowy days!

Little hands color 30 winter pictures, from a snowman, an igloo and a snow angel to skis, a snowplow, a cozy fireplace and winter animals like an arctic fox, a husky and a snowy owl. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, lots of them with smiling faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Snow play: Snowman, Snowballs, Snow Fort, Snow Angel and Igloo
  • Sliding and gliding: Skis, Snowboard, Snow Tube, Ski Lift and Snowmobile
  • Snowy days: Snowplow, Snow Shovel, Icicles, Snow Cloud, Thermometer and Ice Fishing
  • Warm and cozy: Snow Boots, Snowsuit, Cozy Blanket, Fireplace, Hot Soup and Bird Feeder
  • Winter animals: Chickadee, Snowy Owl, Arctic Fox, Snowshoe Hare, Husky, Snow Leopard, Beluga Whale and a Sleepy Bear in its cave
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
